profile.summary: CLC Industries Limited, a textile company, engages in the manufacture and trading of synthetic and cotton yarns in India. The company was formerly known as Spentex Industries Limited and changed its name to CLC Industries Limited in July 2018. CLC Industries Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in New Delhi, India.
